newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador government appoints energy minister.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador government appoints energy minister.

text.p: New Ecuadorean President Fabian Alarcon said Friday he has appointed center-left politician Raul Baca Carbo as energy minister.
"Yes, Mr Baca will take office this afternoon," the president told reporters.
The announcement confirmed earlier reports of his appointment.

Baca was a deputy for the Democratic Left Party which he founded, and as a legislator he opposed the immediate sale of 35 percent of the Ecuadorean Institute of Electricity proposed by the administration of Abdala Bucaram.
He introduced a bill prohibiting the privatization of the stake for three years after the approval of selloff legislation.
Baca served as social welfare minister under the government of Rodrigo Borja from 1988 to 1992 and stood as a presidential candidate in 1992.
